loading.comment: I like the copying one best, but it doesn't fit skeleton, month days and chart plot
loading.reply: The Copying dialog stays the loading, now fitted to every waiting part instead of one picture stretched over all of them: a part that is a box (tile, panel, menu entry) gets the two small folders and the flying sheet with the blocks under them; skeleton lines each carry the sheet hopping along their own length; the month’s days pass one sheet from day to day, a block gained per day; the chart’s plot is crossed by the sheet along its baseline with the blocks filling the plot’s foot. Four options: the fitted Copying (recommended), two variants of it, and your earlier second choice for reference.
